correctness.rationale: Conditioning on all non-triangle edges reduces the problem to the rank contribution of a Bernoulli subgraph on three vertices. The two-component case has expected rank 1-(1-p)^2; the three-component case has expected rank 3p-p^3. Subtracting these from the fully open ranks gives the exact negative component covariance. Adding the three edge-indicator covariances gives the cycle-rank formula and its positive bounds. For p=c/n with c<1, a simple-path union bound makes the exterior three-point state asymptotically fully disconnected.

value.rationale: Triangle count is the basic local cycle motif, while component count and cycle rank are the two graph Betti numbers. The exact identity explains their opposite covariance signs through the ambient connectivity of the triangle's vertices and yields explicit subcritical constants. This is a structural local-to-global relation rather than a recomputation of either marginal statistic.
